description: Delete an email forwarder on a domain on GlobalHostia hosting, or only one of its destinations (forward_to). Mail to that address stops being forwarded, so it needs confirm: true after the customer approves.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the customer has explicitly confirmed this exact change.

forward_to.description: Remove only this destination (default: the whole forwarder)

name: delete_email_forwarder
title: Delete an email forwarder
